title: Grateful Dead Live at Honolulu Civic Auditorium on 1970-01-24
lineage: SBD: MC > cassette > DAT > CD > SHN

ai_review.summary: Clean sound‑board capture of a short, mellow January 1970 Hawaii set highlighted by a stellar Mason's Children and Pigpen’s King Bee.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers surprisingly crisp audio for a 1970 soundboard source, with only occasional drop‑outs and minor pitch quirks noted by one reviewer. Musically the show is praised for its relaxed flow, a slower‑than‑usual Me & My Uncle, a powerhouse Pigpen finale, and standout performances of Mason's Children, Cumberland Blues, Black Peter and Good Lovin'.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star ratings and highlight both excellent performance moments and high‑quality sound; only a single detailed review notes minor dropouts, keeping the overall score in the good‑to‑excellent range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clean and clear for a 1970 SBD; reviewers call it "awesome" and "the cleanest Mason's I've found", with one note about occasional drop‑outs and slight pitch correction needed.

standout_songs: Feedback > And We Bid You Goodnight
show_quality.setlist_flow: A short, single‑set show with a mellow early flow that builds into an energetic Pigpen finale; the pacing feels natural despite its brevity.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for inventive phrasing on Black Peter, strong guitar work on Mason's Children and Good Lovin', and a slower, tasteful Me & My Uncle.
